Specification: This specification is a small test module for unfolding a recursive definition. It models a system with a single state variable, votingPower, which assigns an integer voting power to each process in the fixed set {"a", "b", "c"}, with each power bounded by MAX_POWER. The recursive operator Sum computes the total voting power of a set of processes by choosing an element, adding its voting power, and recursing on the remaining set; the module defines an initial-state predicate, a next-state action that nondeterministically reassigns votingPower within bounds, and an invariant Inv asserting that the total voting power of all processes is less than 10.
